class TransactionLog:
    def __init__(self):
        self.log: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.request_ids: Dict[str, TransactionStatus] = {}

    def record(self, request_id: str, status: TransactionStatus, details: Dict[str, Any]):
        if request_id in self.request_ids:
            # Idempotency check
            if self.request_ids[request_id] == status:
                return True # Already recorded with same status
            else:
                raise TransactionConflictError(f"Request ID {request_id} already exists with different status")
        
        self.request_ids[request_id] = status
        entry = {
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "request_id": request_id,
            "status": status.value,
            "details": details
        }
        self.log.append(entry)
        return True

    def get_status(self, request_id: str) -> Optional[TransactionStatus]:
        if request_id in self.request_ids:
            return self.request_ids[request_id]
        return None

def validate_non_negative_integer(value: Any, name: str) -> int:
